description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance of two methods, labeled “Standard” and “Ours”, across two base models, “Base” and “CORG”. The horizontal axis represents the base model, with labels “Base” and “CORG” in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance”, displays a linear scale ranging from 48 to 62, with tick marks at intervals of 2. For the “Base” model, a gray bar labeled “Standard” reaches approximately 57.6, while a blue bar labeled “Ours” reaches approximately 59.2. For the “CORG” model, the gray “Standard” bar reaches approximately 49.6, and the blue “Ours” bar reaches approximately 61.2. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each base model, representing the performance of each method. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
